text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage with secondary Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy.

The cranial ultrasound confirms bleeding within the ventricles, which explains the seizures and lethargy, likely exacerbated by the hypoxic event (low Apgar) and the initial chorioamnionitis.
